exposure: chemokine CC motif ligand 4 (CCL4 or MIP-1β)
cohort: 40 pregnant women who underwent elective cesarean section (CS) at 38-40 weeks of gestation (control group) and 40 pregnant women with IUGR at 28-37 weeks of gestation (study group)
finding: Elevated amniotic fluid levels of proinflammatory factors, including fractalkine and MIP-1β, along with inflammatory factors such as TNF-α, IL-1β, and IFN-γ, as well as increased HIF-1α levels, are associated with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR).
birth_weight: Measured but specific values not reported
